chapter: Faith, Paris life and later years
title: Playing nowadays: a month a year at Club Saint-Germain, Copenhagen and Germany
summary: He plays with organists in a trio each year, records in Copenhagen and Germany, and made an album with pianist Joe Haider who owns his own company.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, Kenny, I would just like to ask you two things. I mean do you get to -- do you play nowadays? Do you feel the urge to play and do you play?
Well, we play -- I have a guarantee of one month a year. We play at the unintelligible. It's the old Club St. Germaine.
Oh. And who do you play with?
Well, I usually play with organs, you know. Either Lou Bennett, Eddy Louiss, Jimmy Gourley. A trio, you know.
Oh, I see. Well, that's nice.
So this year we're doing the month of December. Sometimes we do the month of August. It all depends on when I'm free and want to play there.
But I usually do a month a year.
: Yeah. That's good. And what else? Do you do any other things, or --
Uh-huh. Like I did the concert with Dexter Sunday.
And I go to Germany, Copenhagen, with Parlan Horace Polens. You know?
And I go up there and we usually make records and I play at the Montmartre, they have a club up there.

And in Germany, at the Domicile, or -- I go up there quite often. As a matter of fact, I couldn't make it this year. September, I was supposed to go, with Benny Bailey and a German pianist, a wonderful pianist, Joe Heider.
His name is. And I was up there last year, at Christmas, as a matter of fact. I finished the 24th of December with them.

And we did a wonderful record date, and we played in a club up there for about five or six days, to kind of get the band in shape. And then we made this album, which was really great. And things like that.
Yeah. Who did you make it for?
Well, for Joe Heider. The piano player has his own -- he owns everything.
He decided, well, it's time for musicians to own their own music. And so he has his own publishing company, his own record company, everything he does himself.
